description: This file contains transformation logic for converting OpenAI embedding request and response formats to Cohere's embedding API format. It defines classes and methods for handling embedding requests, responses, environment validation, and utility functions specific to Cohere embeddings within a larger machine learning or LLM framework.

classes.name: CohereEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Cohere embedding API interactions, including parameter mapping, environment validation, request transformation, and response processing.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns list of supported OpenAI parameters for embedding, specifically 'encoding_format' and 'dimensions'.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool = False, )
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters to optional parameters for Cohere embedding request.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Prepares and validates request headers for the API call, adding authorization if provided.

methods.name: bool _is_v3_model(self, model: str)
methods.description: Checks if the model string corresponds to a v3 model based on presence of '3'.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Returns the API endpoint URL, defaulting to Cohere's embed API if not explicitly specified.

methods.name: CohereEmbeddingRequestWithModel _transform_request( self, model: str, input: List[str], inference_params: dict )
methods.description: Transforms input data into a Cohere-specific embedding request, determining if input is image or text based.

methods.name: dict transform_embedding_request( self, model: str, input: AllEmbeddingInputValues, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms and validates the input for an embedding request, ensuring it is a list of strings.

methods.name: Usage _calculate_usage(self, input: List[str], encoding: Any, meta: dict)
methods.description: Calculates token usage statistics based on input, encoding, and metadata.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse _transform_response( self, response: httpx.Response, api_key: Optional[str], logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, data: Union[dict, CohereEmbeddingRequest], model_response: EmbeddingResponse, model: str, encoding: Any, input: list, )
methods.description: Processes the HTTP response from Cohere API to extract embeddings and update the EmbeddingResponse object.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse transform_embedding_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: EmbeddingResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str], request_data: dict, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Wrapper to process raw response into structured embedding data.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns a CohereError exception with relevant status and message.
